title: Team activation playbook
summary: Invite inactive users in role-based cohorts and run a 30-minute workflow workshop with office hours one week later.

title: Automation adoption guide
summary: Start with one repeatable business workflow, publish a template, name an internal champion, and measure weekly successful runs.

title: Renewal value review
summary: Quantify time saved, active teams, completed workflows, reliability, and the next expansion use case before renewal negotiation.

title: Support recovery protocol
summary: Assign an executive owner, agree on incident milestones, provide daily updates, and close with a written prevention review.
